retention_trigger: packet referenced by public, court, observer, or verifier output
minimum_fields_to_preserve: preserve manifest bytes; object digests; envelope TBS digests; verifier command; archive version
redaction_floor: do not redact content-addressed public artifact bytes; redact only local operator notes outside the packet
review_window: before publication and at packet closeout
non_claims: not outcome certification; not legal advice

retention_trigger: notice publication, correction, rumor-control, or official-channel update
minimum_fields_to_preserve: preserve notice id; channel id; payload digest; issued_at; correction link; feed digest
redaction_floor: bounded public fields only; do not add voter-specific facts
review_window: before notice release and after correction
non_claims: not proof of motive; not outcome certification

retention_trigger: verifier pass, fail, problem-code publication, or independent rerun
minimum_fields_to_preserve: preserve tool version; archive version; problem codes; manifest digest; policy profile digest; run command
redaction_floor: bounded publication: publish stable problem codes rather than raw local paths or private logs
review_window: before public verifier bulletin and at closeout
non_claims: not outcome certification; not proof of intent or fraud

retention_trigger: missingness, liveness, security, or parity observation
minimum_fields_to_preserve: preserve surface id; observation time; digest or status; bounded vantage label; anomaly code
redaction_floor: redact private browsing data, IP-linked identifiers, and unnecessary request bodies
review_window: at observation, before public summary, and after correction
non_claims: not proof of targeting; not proof of intent or fraud

retention_trigger: voter safety, intimidation, observer misconduct, obstruction, or doxxing concern
minimum_fields_to_preserve: preserve incident category; safe channel used; time window; responsible office; after-action pointer
redaction_floor: redact personal identifiers and sensitive safety details unless a lawful policy authorizes disclosure
review_window: immediate triage, public statement review, and after-action closeout
non_claims: not legal advice; not law-enforcement finding; not outcome certification

retention_trigger: AI-assisted draft, translation, summarization, triage output, or correction
minimum_fields_to_preserve: preserve AI-use disclosure; human approver; pre-correction digest; corrected artifact digest; affected languages
redaction_floor: do not preserve voter PII in prompts or public logs; record only bounded disclosure fields
review_window: before publication, before correction, and after-action review
non_claims: not automated rights determination; not outcome certification

retention_trigger: key rotation, key compromise, witness-set change, witness dissent, or health-log concern
minimum_fields_to_preserve: preserve old and new key ids; effective time; signed explanation; witness acknowledgement; dissent record
redaction_floor: publish governance facts and digests; redact private contact details or security-sensitive recovery mechanics
disposition_owner: key ceremony lead plus witness-set coordinator
review_window: before new trust-root reliance and at closeout
non_claims: not proof of compromise impact; not outcome certification

retention_trigger: source review expiry, unpinned live source, citation demotion, or replacement
minimum_fields_to_preserve: preserve source id; role; review_by; reviewer; pinning result; replacement or demotion decision
redaction_floor: do not publish private reviewer notes; preserve public source id and decision rationale
review_window: before release and before live reliance
non_claims: not proof the source is wrong; not legal advice
